annotations.text: The attached run record is signed; this BOM is unsigned. Agent authorship is supplied example context, not a record fact, and the execution layer cannot identify the model. Network isolation is provider configuration, not a separately signed runtime measurement; a granted run reaches only the routes its grant lists, and what reached the other side is not in this record. The run's times are the daemon's own unwitnessed clock. An attached key alone establishes consistency, not signer identity; use an independently trusted key. Display names and the assessor label are unsigned presentation. The attached bundle line proves itself; the whole bundle it belongs to is referenced by digest and checked when supplied. This is run evidence, not an inventory of the image's installed packages. A qualification verdict is the platform's own signed account of one run against a simulated vendor, re-evaluated here from its evidence; it is not an independent audit, and the vendor's ledger is trusted as the signer read it.
